instruction: Look at task-12_blank_seed.dxf. Start from the blank seed. Draw the 80 x 140 keyhole plate as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with corners at (0,0), (80,0), (80,140), and (0,140). Add a circular cutout centered at (40,100) with radius 12 on layer CUTOUT and a 10-wide vertical slot rectangle with opposite corners (35,35) and (45,88) on layer SLOT. Add text ACAD-12 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
